text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As summer training camp began, news spread 
that the Mile Championship Nambu Hai would 
be held in Tokyo in consideration of the 
conditions in the disaster-stricken area.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The disaster changed everything. Having 
lost both her thrill and her smile, 
Transcend puts aside data on top 
contenders, telling herself, "Running 
isn't what I should be thinking about 
right now."

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Rethinking the meaning of running, she 
decided that even more than racing, she 
wanted to properly support the 
disaster-stricken areas.
